req.title: Include Content-Length on echo responses
req.statement: The system shall include a Content-Length header equal to the response body byte length on echo endpoints.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the Content-Length header must be included in the response of echo endpoints, matching the byte length of the response body. This ensures that clients can correctly interpret the size of the response. The tests will verify this behavior across different HTTP methods, ensuring compliance with the requirement.

tests.name: test_content_length_on_get
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a GET request to the /get endpoint.
expected: The Content-Length header is present and matches the byte length of the response body.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.get('/get')
assert response.status_code == 200
content_length = int(response.headers['Content-Length'])
assert content_length == len(response.data)

tests.name: test_content_length_on_post_with_empty_body
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
actions: Send a POST request to the /post endpoint with an empty body.
expected: The Content-Length header is present and matches the byte length of the response body, which should be minimal.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.post('/post', data='')
assert response.status_code == 200
content_length = int(response.headers['Content-Length'])
assert content_length == len(response.data)

tests.name: test_content_length_on_invalid_method
preconditions: The httpbin app is running and accessible.
The /get endpoint does not support POST method.
actions: Send a POST request to the /get endpoint.
expected: The response status code is 405 (Method Not Allowed).
The Content-Length header is not required in this case.
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()
response = client.post('/get')
assert response.status_code == 405
try:
    content_length = response.headers['Content-Length']
    assert False, 'Content-Length should not be present'
except KeyError:
    pass
